newsitem.title: USA: Film funding flat in Florida for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Film funding flat in Florida for 1996.

text.p: Spending by Hollywood production companies was flat in Florida last year, totalling just over an estimated $600 million in comparision with the $597 million spent in 1995, a state group said on Tuesday.
But 1995 posted exceptionally strong year-over-year gains, rising $145 million from the $342 million spent the previous year.

According to the Florida Entertainment Industry Council, a public-private venture set up by Florida's government, the cities of Orlando, Miami, Fort Lauderdale, Palm Beach, Tampa and Jacksonsville were the most popular venues in Florida for teams making films, television programs and commericials.
The council said its 1996 figures were preliminary and that final figures were scheduled to issued in February. ((--
